snippet.title: Escape Simulator 2: Apocalypse DLC - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4575720/Escape_Simulator_2_Apocalypse_DLC/

This Escape Simulator 2 DLC takes you into a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization is gone, but the clues are still there. Your goal is to follow the trail, solve your way through what’s left behind, and search for Sanctuary.
